te: Draft report on a policy to increase forest and green areas, and 2 new working groups
se: The meeting noted progress on the draft study report on a flexible, quick-win policy framework for national forestry and more green area for the country. The draft has 5 chapters and aims at green areas of 55 per cent of the country by 2037 under the 20-year National Strategy. It says that in 2025 forest covered 31.43 per cent of the country, while the national forest policy sets at least 40 per cent. The meeting suggested, for example, a single standard for forest area statistics, more research and follow-up, wider use of SMART Patrol, and working with agencies outside the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment. It also set up 2 new working groups: one on a quick-win forestry policy and one on the wild elephant and community problem.
it: Progress on the draft study report: a flexible, quick-win policy framework for national forestry and more green area for the country
The subcommittee's work framework: 2 new working groups (quick-win forestry policy, and wild elephants and communities)
